name: Sex Therapist
source: Shoko Sugimoto has opened a massage salon dedicated to healing both the mind and body, drawing on her extensive qualifications. Joining her as a trusted right-hand partner is Chuck, a massage therapist who specializes in female clients. Together, they've been preparing to provide the ultimate relaxation experience.
translation: 杉本翔子充分发挥自己丰富的专业资质，开办了一家致力于疗愈身心的按摩沙龙。作为得力搭档加入她麾下的，是专精女性顾客护理的按摩师查克。两人携手筹备，只为给顾客带来极致的放松体验。
